# OpenAI skill validator snapshot

`quick_validate.py` is an unmodified snapshot of OpenAI's official
`skill-creator` validator:

- Source: <https://github.com/openai/skills/blob/main/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py>
- Retrieved: 2026-07-16
- SHA-256: `6cc9dc3199c935916cf6f73fcbbbb0e3bb1b58c8f5109fefa499978908164f51`

digest. Upstream terms apply to this vendored file.
